payload.title: File:Ceratopsian fossils Sternberg Museum.jpg
payload.description_html: Ceratopsian fossils on display at the Sternberg Museum of Natural History in Hays, Kansas. Including a Triceratops horn core and predentary, and a Chasmosaurus skin impression.
